{%- assign seo_url = site.url | append: site.baseurl -%}
# {{ site.name }} (LIACS, Leiden University)

> {{ site.description }}

The {{ site.name }} (NaCo), formerly the Natural Computing Group, is part of the Leiden Institute of Advanced Computer Science (LIACS) at Leiden University, the Netherlands. It is led by Prof. Thomas Bäck (cluster head).

## Main pages

- [Home]({{ seo_url }}/): overview of the cluster and its research areas
- [Research projects]({{ seo_url }}/research/): current and finished research projects
- [People]({{ seo_url }}/people/): faculty, researchers, PhD candidates and alumni
- [News]({{ seo_url }}/blog/): announcements and news
- [Events]({{ seo_url }}/events/): workshops, special sessions and tutorials we organise
- [Contact]({{ seo_url }}/contact/)
